sections.Profile:
"Showtime" and "Dolphin" are electro-mechanical pinball machines released by Chicago Coin in 1974. "Showtime" is a four-player game, while "Dolphin" supports two players. Both machines feature two flippers, two pop bumpers, seven rollover buttons, and three captive balls.

- Manufacturer: Chicago Coin Machine Mfg. Co.
- Years made: 1974
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 2
- Tags: Two player, Good Times, Swimming, Original Theme, Dolphins, 1970s
